result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mostly around content being clipped and a loading indicator appearing over already-rendered content.

issues.description: A loading spinner is visible in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the restaurant card and image content appear to be loaded.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image/card content has finished loading, or show a proper skeleton state before the content appears.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant feed; the next restaurant image is partially hidden behind the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable elements are abruptly clipped at the right edge, including the category chips and the third card in the “Fastest near you” row.
issues.suggestion: If these are carousels, add clearer horizontal scroll affordance, spacing, or a fade edge so the clipping feels intentional rather than broken.
